diagram.title: Map of ORG's sites, previews, and proposals
diagram.desc: ORG's organization holds org-frontend, deployed to orgspirituality.org on Netlify, and org-backend, deployed as an API on Heroku that the site calls. It also holds its profile, brand assets, the private source for the ORG AstroLog, which publishes the official changelog to GitHub Pages, and the entry portal, which also serves the arrival kit every ORG page shares. Christopher's private dApp source syncs public files to the dApp preview, which copies artwork and words from org-frontend. Renan T's design directions, now kept as history, are on Netlify, and their three lights live on in the AstroLog, as are the logo files from brand-assets. The drasticstatic ORG lab, synced from its own private source, keeps the changelog and portfolio of what Christopher builds for ORG.
